task_description: Implement a complete rule-based prediction engine for EDS component classification. The engine extracts interpretable IF/THEN rules from the training CSV data, stores them as versioned JSON, and provides a production inference engine that evaluates rules deterministically with confidence scoring, conflict resolution, and fallback behavior. Integrates with the existing repository architecture. All code uses only Python stdlib (environment constraint). Includes comprehensive pytest test suite and developer documentation.

verification.summary: All 158 tests pass (pytest tests/ -v). All 23 Python files parse without syntax errors. Rule engine correctly predicts all 36 component classes with 91.58% test accuracy. Rules.json is valid. Rule generation is reproducible. No third-party dependencies used in rule_engine/ or training/.
